name: Tilt-out bin unit, 9 bins, 600 mm, open
description:
This is the open configuration of TB609: every clear acrylic bin is tilted forward on its bottom pivot by 35 degrees (a typical stop, not a measured figure), so the opening and the usable volume are visible for storage planning. TB609 is the same unit closed.

External dimensions: depth 62 mm, width 600 mm, height 77 mm.

No formal standard. Metric and US ranges share one 600 mm (23 5/8 in) width with 2/3/4/5/6/9-bin units, so units of different bin counts stack into one wall. Matches Akro-Mils TiltView 0670N.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 3,172 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Tilt-out bin unit, 9 bins, 62 x 600 x 77 mm - true-scale GLB of a 600 mm wide multi-cell tilt-bin housing for shelving and parts storage, shown with every bin tilted open (35 degrees, assumed).
